def predict_take_on(f: dict, p: dict) -> int:
    is_tight_space = f["distance_m"] < p["tight_space_distance_m"]

    is_direct_approach = f["approach_angle_deg"] < p["direct_approach_angle_deg"]
    is_closing_fast = f["closing_speed_mps"] > p["high_closing_speed_mps"]
    is_under_pressure = is_tight_space and (is_direct_approach or is_closing_fast)

    has_space_beyond = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["min_space_after_beat_m"]
    has_low_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] < p["support_min_count"]
    has_support = not has_low_support

    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_risk_distance_m"]
    is_in_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_distance_m"]

    is_carrier_faster = f["carrier_speed_mps"] >= f["opponent_speed_mps"]

    favorable_context = has_space_beyond and (has_support or is_in_attacking_third)
    risky_but_ok = is_pinned_to_sideline and is_carrier_faster and has_space_beyond

    if is_tight_space:
        if is_pinned_to_sideline and not has_space_beyond:
            take_on = False
        else:
            take_on = is_under_pressure and (favorable_context or risky_but_ok)
    else:
        take_on = has_space_beyond and is_in_attacking_third and has_support

    return 1 if take_on else 0

def predict_take_on(f: dict, p: dict) -> int:
    is_tight_space = f["distance_m"] < p["tight_space_distance_m"]
    has_space_after_beat = f["second_nearest_dist_m"] > p["space_after_beat_distance_m"]
    is_pinned_to_sideline = f["dist_to_sideline_m"] < p["sideline_danger_distance_m"]
    is_in_attacking_third = f["dist_to_goal_line_m"] < p["attacking_third_distance_m"]
    has_support = f["n_supporting_teammates"] >= p["support_min_count"]
    is_closing_fast = f["closing_speed_mps"] > p["high_closing_speed_mps"]
    is_opponent_retreating = f["closing_speed_mps"] < 0
    carrier_faster_than_opponent = f["carrier_speed_mps"] > f["opponent_speed_mps"]

    # 必須条件: 間合いが詰まっていて、かわした後に空間がある
    base_condition = is_tight_space and has_space_after_beat

    if not base_condition:
        return 0

    # 加点方式でリスクに見合うメリットを評価
    score = 0.0
    score += 1.0 if has_support else 0.0
    score += 1.0 if is_in_attacking_third else 0.0
    score += 1.0 if carrier_faster_than_opponent else 0.0
    score += 1.0 if is_closing_fast or is_opponent_retreating else 0.0
    score -= 1.0 if is_pinned_to_sideline and not (has_support and carrier_faster_than_opponent) else 0.0

    should_take_on = score >= p["score_threshold"]

    return 1 if should_take_on else 0
